Container.Name: fennel
Container.Overview: Fennel is a small autonomous frog living in a floating island town, day and night. His thoughts and choices are written by Claude; he keeps a diary, draws, writes pages, researches on the web, and reflects on each day. Visitors can watch him in 3D and leave notes.

Config.Name: Fennel's memories
Config.Description: Where his world, diary and memories are saved, with daily backups.

Config.Name: Claude API key
Config.Description: Your key from the Claude Console. Without it he runs on simple rules.

Config.Name: Keeper key
Config.Description: A password you choose, for adding things and books to his town from the web page.

Config.Name: Time scale
Config.Description: Town minutes per real minute. 4 = a town day every 6 real hours.

Config.Name: Max Claude calls per day
Config.Description: Hard daily cap. After it, he runs on simple rules until midnight UTC.

Config.Name: Max web searches per day
Config.Description: Daily cap on web searches during library research.

Config.Name: Everyday model
Config.Description: Model for moment-to-moment thoughts and choices.

Config.Name: Reflection model
Config.Description: Model for bedtime reflection and the pages he writes.

Config.Name: Research model
Config.Description: Model for library research with web search.
